scope: Mock-DOM user actions, async navigation races, safe text rendering, and isolated execution of actual Studio lifecycle/render gates.

results.name: Opening the page selects Overview without importing or activating 3D
First Studio click loads once, pauses video, and selects its accessible tab
Returning to Overview deactivates Studio; reopening reuses its module
Returning to Overview during pending import never leaves Studio active
Concurrent Studio requests share import and only the latest target opens
Import failure shows a retry message and a second selection retries successfully
Hardware shortcut requests the ME120 stereo lesson and moves to the tabs
Arrow, Home, and End keys change tabs with focus and roving tab index
Hidden documents pause Overview video without autoplaying on return
Unknown navigation destinations do not mutate the selected page or load 3D
Capability panels support mouse hover, keyboard focus, and touch click with one expanded panel
Photo viewer displays caption as text and returns focus to the originating thumbnail
Photo viewer is optional when its dialog is absent
Studio deactivation neutralizes held controls and all animated actuators
An old target waiting for models cannot change a newly reopened Studio
Scene frames skip effects, camera, inspection, and WebGL work while inactive or hidden
